title: Streaming Responses

body.text: piece by piece in real time, instead of waiting until it's done and sending the whole block
— users see the text flow out instantly, and the feeling of 'fast' is very different, even if total processing time is the same.

example: "Without streaming: a silent screen for 15 seconds, then the whole answer appears / With streaming: text starts flowing within 1 second"

title: Use streaming in real apps

body.text: stream: true, then receive events piece by piece and append them to the display
— chat and writing tools should always stream, while background jobs nobody is watching don't need it.

example: "A web chatbot → stream so the user sees the system working / a nightly report cron job → no need to stream"

options.text: Sending the answer piece by piece in real time

question: What does streaming mainly help with?
